dataset: Full Leiden/CWTS-universe NF and ANS, RAW and REF, 2023 and 2024
scope: Entire L recursive state. No conditioning on JCR membership, benchmark availability or comparison support.
state_rule: Dated CWTS primary_core true and positive RAW article count or incidence to a positive RAW edge; state held fixed across treatments.
membership_mapping: Release rows require historical ISSN-L; exact OpenAlex source-ID projection; missing release source arms leave membership undefined.
verification: Full L membership agrees with CWTS flags and RAW activity.
NF mass is 100 per year and treatment.
ANS agrees with NF/100 divided by eligible article share.
construction: Existing precomputed scores; solver was not rerun for this package.

additional_n_nodes.selection: Entire N recursive-state node set minus the published Opindx journal export. No JCR or benchmark condition.
additional_n_nodes.reason: The website export filters source types; full N analysis retains these scoring-state members.
additional_n_nodes.attribution: Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), Norwegian Register for Scientific Journals, Series and Publishers, input vintage 2026-07-26.
